messages:
sara-partnerships: Quick sync — we need a single readiness checklist for the marketplace launch that covers press/blog/landing + HW partner assets + SI integration tests. Can folks confirm who owns which slice?

mike-gTM: I can take coord for press/blog/landing. Targeting dry-run week of May 6. Need embargo window and final asset drop dates. :calendar:

olga-hw-partner: HW side: we'll have firmware image and device photos ready by May 3, integration SDK by May 4. Will need staging tenant for validation.

devin-si-lead: SI integration: our test matrix needs a staging tenant + sample dataset and a basic runbook. Can ops spin up tenant earlier?

launch-bot: Deploy request received: staging-tenant request queued, ETA 48h for provisioning.

sara-partnerships: Perfect. mike — can you list embargo timing? alex — can comms prep blog draft for review by May 1?

mike-gTM: Embargo idea: press embargo on May 8 at 10am PT; internal preview May 7. Final assets (press kit + screenshots + partner quotes) by May 5 EOD.

alex-commops: I’ll draft blog + release notes. Can we get partner quotes from olga by May 2? Prefer short quotes + headshots.

olga-hw-partner: Yes — I’ll get legal signoff first. Expect quote and headshot by May 2 EOD.

nina-legal: Quick note: partner quotes must go through legal approval. Send to me once you have them (nina-legal). I’ll try to turn around within 24h.

devin-si-lead: For SI tests — list of validation checks (high level): auth, provisioning, inference latency smoke, model rollback test, telemetry. I’ll add exact commands later but want to confirm staging availability.

sara-partnerships: Good list. mike/olga — we need someone to own the landing page checklist: CTA, partner badge, region availability, marketplace listing copy, screenshots, pricing stub.

mike-gTM: I’ll own landing page content + marketplace listing copy. sara — can you own partner badge and partner co-marketing assets?

sara-partnerships: Yep. I’ll coordinate creative and badge delivery. Also, partner studio needs brand guidelines — olga, can you drop the brand kit link here?

olga-hw-partner: Brand kit: https://files.partnerco/brand-kit.zip — includes badge options. Note: one variant needs color tweak per legal.

nina-legal: Color tweak approved for the light badge only. Dark badge needs alternate wording. I’ll send the exact copy.

devin-si-lead: Ops asked for sample run commands. Will post tomorrow but this is our high-level staging checklist:

``` 
1) Provision staging tenant
2) Install partner SDK + firmware (if applicable)
3) Run auth smoke test
4) Run inference end-to-end sample (10 requests)
5) Validate telemetry ingestion
6) Perform rollback to prior model
```

alex-commops: Thanks. For press embargo — do we have an embargo contact list for reporters? I can prep and send with the embargo notice.

mike-gTM: Yes — I’ll assemble the list and share by May 3.

sara-partnerships: Risks/blockers? Anything that would delay dry-run?

olga-hw-partner: Potential blocker: a firmware signing issue we discovered — engineering estimates fix by Apr 30. If delayed, we can still run software-only flows.

devin-si-lead: Another risk: staging tenant quota limits could slow parallel SI tests. ops, please prioritize test quota during dry-run window.

launch-bot: Reminder: dry-run calendar invite sent to #partnerships for May 7 09:00 PT.

sara-partnerships: Thanks bot. Action items summary: mike — embargo & landing copy; alex — blog draft by May 1; olga — partner quote + headshot by May 2; nina — legal review on receipt; devin — SI test matrix + commands; ops — staging tenant + quota. If anyone needs to reassign, say so here. :+1:

mike-gTM: Acknowledged, will update a shared checklist doc and ping when done.

olga-hw-partner: Acknowledged.

nina-legal: Acknowledged.

devin-si-lead: Acknowledged — will post commands tomorrow.

alex-commops: Acknowledged — will share first draft by EOD May 1.

sara-partnerships: Great. Closing this thread — please update the checklist doc (link in #partners-assets) as you complete items.

launch-bot: Checklist doc: https://docs.redwood/partners-assets/checklist (updated).
